--- grant_execute_on_function.sql
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION udfscope.f TO ROLE udf_reader

--- AST
&ast.Grant{
  Privilege: &ast.ExecutePrivilegeOnFunction{
    Execute: 6,
    Names:   []*ast.Path{
      &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 26,
            NameEnd: 34,
            Name:    "udfscope",
          },
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 35,
            NameEnd: 36,
            Name:    "f",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Roles: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 45,
      NameEnd: 55,
      Name:    "udf_reader",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION udfscope.f TO ROLE udf_reader
